summary: Interactive romantic Valentine single-page web page (HTML/CSS/JS) with Cover -> Neha note screen(s) with lots of small teddy visuals -> Yes/No prompt (evasive No on hover) -> meme image shown on Yes with text "Good choice".
architectural_notes: Implement as a single-page static HTML file with embedded CSS/JS for easy local running.
Add a second screen/page in the single-page flow (e.g., show/hide sections) to display the personalized "Neha" note after the initial opening.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Romantic illustration of a boy kneeling on one knee proposing to a girl while wishing her Happy Propose Day, soft pink/romantic palette (propose-day-scene.dim_1024x768.png)

existing_features.title: Create a single-purpose interactive Valentine page that asks: "Will you be my Valentine?" with exactly two options: "Yes" and "No".
Implement evasive behavior for the "No" button: when the user hovers over it (pointer/mouse), the button moves away so it cannot be clicked.
When the user clicks "Yes", replace the prompt experience with a celebratory meme-style image and display the text: "Good choice" (exact capitalization).
Apply a cohesive romantic visual theme using a pink and white color scheme, with consistent typography and layout.

Provide a polished, creative, coherent UI theme direction (colors within pink/white palette, typography pairing, spacing, and a simple romantic motif such as hearts) and apply it consistently across the page.
Add the generated meme image as a static frontend asset and render it directly from the frontend (do not fetch it from the backend). Store generated images under frontend/public/assets/generated.
Add a new initial 'cover' screen that appears before the existing Valentine question screen, showing the name "Neha" prominently and a clear call-to-action to open the note.

Implement a second screen (shown after opening from the cover) that displays the provided note text exactly (English), with a romantic layout and 'lots of small teddies' decorative motif, and a control to proceed to the existing Valentine question experience.

Ensure the screen flow is: Cover ("Neha") -> Note -> existing Valentine question (Yes/No with evasive No) -> existing "Good choice" meme screen (on Yes). The Yes/No choice must only appear on the Valentine question screen.
Add and render teddy-themed static image assets from the frontend (do not fetch from backend) to support the 'lots of small teddies' decoration on the cover and note screens.

Update the Note screen content to include the additional Propose Day message text exactly as provided, preserving line breaks and punctuation, appended after the existing note text:

"Happy Propose Day
Life will be more beautiful if you are with me."

Add a Propose Day themed illustration to the Note experience, matching this visual description: "A boy is wishing a girl Happy Propose Day while proposing to her, kneeling down on one knee." Render it as a static frontend image asset on the Note screen (no backend fetch).

new_feature_requests.summary: Build a self-contained romantic Valentine ask web page (HTML/CSS/JS) with pink/white theme, Yes/No choices, evasive No button on hover, and a meme image/message displayed after clicking Yes.
Add a personalized note experience: include the name "Neha" (with lots of small teddies) and a second page/screen shown after opening that displays the provided Propose Day romantic note text.
Add a Propose Day themed illustration/image asset (boy proposing on one knee, wishing Happy Propose Day) to accompany the Neha note content, rendered as a static frontend asset (no backend fetch).

projectName: Romantic Valentine single-page ask with evasive No button and Yes meme reveal
